 Print Boney Kapoor ’s hair transformation became a talking point in 2024 after the film producer underwent a hair transplant. Now, his children, Janhvi Kapoor and Arjun Kapoor , have shared an interesting revelation about the procedure, claiming that their father was paid to get it done. The disclosure came during the latest episode of ‘ Koffee With Karan ’, when host Karan Johar asked Janhvi to share an entertaining rumour about her father that she would like to spread as part of the rapid-fire round. Janhvi was quick to respond, joking, “That he didn’t get a hair transplant done. And he grew his hair by concentrating.” Her brother Arjun burst out laughing before adding, “But if you roam around, you wouldn’t believe it.” Janhvi then asked Arjun, “Have you seen dad’s banners?” To this, he replied, “That’s called marketing.” Karan Johar soon brought up Boney’s makeover, saying, “I forgot to talk about Boney Ji’s makeover.” This prompted Janhvi to reveal, “Can I tell you that he has been paid to get a hair transplant?” A surprised Karan asked, “What, he got paid?” Both Janhvi and Arjun confirmed that it was true. Watch Boney Kapoor Drops 26 Kg Without Gym: Emotional Journey Behind the Transformation Clarifying what she meant, Janhvi added, “He has not paid to get a hair transplant. He has gotten paid.” Varun Dhawan , who was also present during the conversation, praised the producer, saying, “But his hair looks amazing.” Karan, still taken aback by the revelation, asked, “So he is paid, that’s why he is smashed all over the city?” The siblings once again confirmed his assumption. Janhvi also revealed that more promotional banners featuring her father were in the pipeline. “There are more coming. I have got an approval of five more banners of him looking in the mirror without hair, sad, and with hair, happy,” she said, leaving the others laughing. Boney first drew attention to his hair transformation in 2024, when he travelled to Hyderabad for the inauguration of a hair transplant clinic. A video of the producer discussing his procedure subsequently surfaced online, in which he spoke about Eugenix and its role in his hair transplant. He later opened up about his decision to undergo the procedure, along with his weight-loss journey. Speaking at a press conference organised by the clinic, Boney recalled how his late wife, Sridevi , had encouraged him to lose weight before addressing his hair loss.
